title: "Extraction Descripteurs Accélérométriques"
author: "Benjamin & Yasser"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r packages}
library(read.gt3x)
library(tibble)
library(RcppRoll)
library(moments)
library(nonlinearTseries)
library(entropy)
```

Étape 1 du projet : lit les enregistrements bruts `.gt3x` (accéléromètre tri-axial,
100 Hz) de chaque patient, retire les périodes d'inactivité (sommeil + non-port),
calcule 118 descripteurs par patient et les écrit dans `data/matrice_descripteurs.csv`,
qui est l'entrée de `02_modelisation.R`.

Les chemins sont relatifs à la racine du projet (dossier qui contient ce fichier).

```{r parametres}
chemin_dossier <- "data/gt3x"          # dossier contenant les fichiers .gt3x
chemin_sortie  <- "data/matrice_descripteurs.csv"
n_echantillonnage <- 100               # décimation 1/100 : 100 Hz -> 1 Hz pour la détection
freq_orig <- 100                       # fréquence du capteur (Hz)
duree_fenetre_min <- 5                 # fenêtre de l'écart-type glissant (min)
seuil_sd <- 0.01                       # seuil d'écart-type de la norme (g) en dessous duquel = inactif
taille_fenetre_eveil_sec <- 60         # éveil < 60 s au milieu d'une inactivité -> inactif
taille_fenetre_nonwear_sec <- 60       # inactivité < 60 s au milieu d'un éveil -> éveil
fenetre_rolling <- 1000                # fenêtre des descripteurs glissants (échantillons, 10 s)
step_dfa_glissante <- 100000           # pas entre deux fenêtres DFA / entropie (échantillons)
```

```{r detection}
files <- list.files(path = chemin_dossier, pattern = "\\.gt3x$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(files) == 0) stop("Aucun fichier .gt3x trouvé")
```

```{r fonction}
extraire_descripteurs <- function(filepath, n_echantillonnage, step_dfa) {
  
  patient_id <- basename(filepath)
  
  data <- read.gt3x(filepath, asDataFrame = TRUE)
  data_df <- as_tibble(data)
  data_df$norme <- sqrt(data_df$X^2 + data_df$Y^2 + data_df$Z^2)
  
  points_par_sec <- freq_orig / n_echantillonnage
  width_reel <- duree_fenetre_min * 60 * points_par_sec
  taille_fenetre_eveil <- taille_fenetre_eveil_sec * freq_orig
  taille_fenetre_nonwear <- taille_fenetre_nonwear_sec * freq_orig
  
  idx_sample <- seq(1, nrow(data_df), by = n_echantillonnage)
  data_sample <- data_df[idx_sample, ]
  
  start_time <- as.POSIXct("2026-01-01 09:00:00")
  pas_en_secondes <- n_echantillonnage / freq_orig
  data_sample$time <- start_time + seq(0, nrow(data_sample)-1) * pas_en_secondes
  
  data_sample$sd_temp <- roll_sd(data_sample$norme, n = width_reel, fill = NA, align = "center")
  data_sample$inactif <- ifelse(data_sample$sd_temp < seuil_sd, 1, 0)
  data_sample$inactif[is.na(data_sample$inactif)] <- 0
  
  inactif_full <- rep(data_sample$inactif, each = n_echantillonnage)
  data_df$inactif <- inactif_full[1:nrow(data_df)]
  
  # Lissage : les courtes périodes d'éveil (< 60 s) au milieu d'une inactivité deviennent inactives
  sequences <- rle(data_df$inactif)
  interruptions_courtes_eveil <- sequences$values == 0 & sequences$lengths < taille_fenetre_eveil
  sequences$values[interruptions_courtes_eveil] <- 1
  # Recalcul du RLE pour fusionner les segments devenus contigus : sans cela, les segments
  # qui viennent d'être passés à 1 (tous < 60 s) seraient remis à 0 par l'étape suivante
  sequences <- rle(inverse.rle(sequences))
  # Les courtes inactivités (< 60 s) au milieu d'un éveil redeviennent de l'éveil
  interruptions_courtes_nonwear <- sequences$values == 1 & sequences$lengths < taille_fenetre_nonwear
  sequences$values[interruptions_courtes_nonwear] <- 0
  data_df$inactif <- inverse.rle(sequences)
  
  data_df$time <- start_time + seq(0, nrow(data_df)-1) / freq_orig
  data_awake <- data_df[data_df$inactif == 0, ]
  
  desc_global <- c(
    X_mean = mean(data_awake$X, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_sd = sd(data_awake$X, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q00 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q10 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q20 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q30 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.30, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q40 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.40, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q50 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q60 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.60, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q70 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.70, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q80 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q90 = quantile(data_awake$X, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_q100 = quantile(data_awake$X, 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_kurtosis = kurtosis(data_awake$X),
    X_skewness = skewness(data_awake$X),
    
    Y_mean = mean(data_awake$Y, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_sd = sd(data_awake$Y, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q00 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q10 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q20 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q30 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.30, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q40 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.40, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q50 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q60 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.60, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q70 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.70, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q80 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q90 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_q100 = quantile(data_awake$Y, 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_kurtosis = kurtosis(data_awake$Y),
    Y_skewness = skewness(data_awake$Y),
    
    Z_mean = mean(data_awake$Z, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_sd = sd(data_awake$Z, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q00 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q10 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q20 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q30 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.30, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q40 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.40, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q50 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q60 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.60, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q70 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.70, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q80 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q90 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_q100 = quantile(data_awake$Z, 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_kurtosis = kurtosis(data_awake$Z),
    Z_skewness = skewness(data_awake$Z),
    
    norme_mean = mean(data_awake$norme, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_sd = sd(data_awake$norme, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q00 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q10 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q20 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.20, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q30 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.30, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q40 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.40, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q50 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q60 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.60, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q70 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.70, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q80 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.80, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q90 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_q100 = quantile(data_awake$norme, 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_kurtosis = kurtosis(data_awake$norme),
    norme_skewness = skewness(data_awake$norme)
  )
  
  desc_utilisation <- c(
    nonwear_duration_hours = sum(data_df$inactif) / (freq_orig * 3600),
    nonwear_percentage = (sum(data_df$inactif) / nrow(data_df)) * 100
  )
  
  n_win <- nrow(data_awake)
  idx_windows <- seq(fenetre_rolling, n_win, by = fenetre_rolling)
  
  X_sd_roll_vals <- numeric(length(idx_windows))
  Y_sd_roll_vals <- numeric(length(idx_windows))
  Z_sd_roll_vals <- numeric(length(idx_windows))
  norme_sd_roll_vals <- numeric(length(idx_windows))
  
  X_var_roll_vals <- numeric(length(idx_windows))
  Y_var_roll_vals <- numeric(length(idx_windows))
  Z_var_roll_vals <- numeric(length(idx_windows))
  norme_var_roll_vals <- numeric(length(idx_windows))
  
  for (i in seq_along(idx_windows)) {
    pos <- idx_windows[i]
    window_data <- data_awake[(pos - fenetre_rolling + 1):pos, ]
    
    X_sd_roll_vals[i] <- sd(window_data$X, na.rm = TRUE)
    Y_sd_roll_vals[i] <- sd(window_data$Y, na.rm = TRUE)
    Z_sd_roll_vals[i] <- sd(window_data$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
    norme_sd_roll_vals[i] <- sd(window_data$norme, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    X_var_roll_vals[i] <- var(window_data$X, na.rm = TRUE)
    Y_var_roll_vals[i] <- var(window_data$Y, na.rm = TRUE)
    Z_var_roll_vals[i] <- var(window_data$Z, na.rm = TRUE)
    norme_var_roll_vals[i] <- var(window_data$norme, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  desc_glissants <- c(
    X_sd_roll_mean = mean(X_sd_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_sd_roll_sd = sd(X_sd_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_sd_roll_mean = mean(Y_sd_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_sd_roll_sd = sd(Y_sd_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_sd_roll_mean = mean(Z_sd_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_sd_roll_sd = sd(Z_sd_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_sd_roll_mean = mean(norme_sd_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_sd_roll_sd = sd(norme_sd_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    X_var_roll_mean = mean(X_var_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_var_roll_sd = sd(X_var_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_var_roll_mean = mean(Y_var_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_var_roll_sd = sd(Y_var_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_var_roll_mean = mean(Z_var_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_var_roll_sd = sd(Z_var_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_var_roll_mean = mean(norme_var_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_var_roll_sd = sd(norme_var_roll_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  f_dfa_complet <- function(x) {
    x_clean <- x[!is.na(x)]
    
    if (length(x_clean) < 100) return(c(alpha = NA, r2 = NA))
    if (sd(x_clean) == 0) return(c(alpha = NA, r2 = NA))
    if (any(!is.finite(x_clean))) return(c(alpha = NA, r2 = NA))
    
    result <- tryCatch({
      mod <- dfa(x_clean, window.size.range = c(10, floor(length(x_clean)/3)), 
                 npoints = 20, do.plot = FALSE)
      alpha <- estimate(mod)[[1]]
      sizes <- mod$window.sizes
      fluct <- mod$fluctuation.function
      
      if (any(!is.finite(fluct)) || any(!is.finite(sizes))) {
        return(c(alpha = NA, r2 = NA))
      }
      
      df_temp <- data.frame(x = log(sizes), y = log(fluct))
      df_temp <- df_temp[is.finite(df_temp$x) & is.finite(df_temp$y), ]
      
      if (nrow(df_temp) < 5) return(c(alpha = NA, r2 = NA))
      
      lm_temp <- lm(y ~ x, df_temp)
      r2 <- summary(lm_temp)$r.squared
      
      c(alpha = alpha, r2 = r2)
    }, error = function(e) {
      c(alpha = NA, r2 = NA)
    })
    
    return(result)
  }
  
  idx_dfa <- seq(fenetre_rolling, n_win, by = step_dfa)
  
  X_alpha_vals <- numeric(length(idx_dfa))
  X_r2_vals <- numeric(length(idx_dfa))
  Y_alpha_vals <- numeric(length(idx_dfa))
  Y_r2_vals <- numeric(length(idx_dfa))
  Z_alpha_vals <- numeric(length(idx_dfa))
  Z_r2_vals <- numeric(length(idx_dfa))
  norme_alpha_vals <- numeric(length(idx_dfa))
  norme_r2_vals <- numeric(length(idx_dfa))
  
  for (i in seq_along(idx_dfa)) {
    pos <- idx_dfa[i]
    
    res_X <- f_dfa_complet(data_awake$X[(pos - fenetre_rolling + 1):pos])
    X_alpha_vals[i] <- res_X["alpha"]
    X_r2_vals[i] <- res_X["r2"]
    
    res_Y <- f_dfa_complet(data_awake$Y[(pos - fenetre_rolling + 1):pos])
    Y_alpha_vals[i] <- res_Y["alpha"]
    Y_r2_vals[i] <- res_Y["r2"]
    
    res_Z <- f_dfa_complet(data_awake$Z[(pos - fenetre_rolling + 1):pos])
    Z_alpha_vals[i] <- res_Z["alpha"]
    Z_r2_vals[i] <- res_Z["r2"]
    
    res_norme <- f_dfa_complet(data_awake$norme[(pos - fenetre_rolling + 1):pos])
    norme_alpha_vals[i] <- res_norme["alpha"]
    norme_r2_vals[i] <- res_norme["r2"]
  }
  
  idx_ent <- seq(fenetre_rolling, n_win, by = step_dfa)
  
  X_entrop_vals <- rep(NA_real_, length(idx_ent))
  Y_entrop_vals <- rep(NA_real_, length(idx_ent))
  Z_entrop_vals <- rep(NA_real_, length(idx_ent))
  norme_entrop_vals <- rep(NA_real_, length(idx_ent))
  
  for (i in seq_along(idx_ent)) {
    pos <- idx_ent[i]
    
    x_X <- data_awake$X[(pos - fenetre_rolling + 1):pos]
    bins_X <- cut(x_X, breaks = 10, labels = FALSE)
    bins_X <- bins_X[!is.na(bins_X)]
    if (length(bins_X) > 0) {
      X_entrop_vals[i] <- entropy(table(bins_X))
    }
    
    x_Y <- data_awake$Y[(pos - fenetre_rolling + 1):pos]
    bins_Y <- cut(x_Y, breaks = 10, labels = FALSE)
    bins_Y <- bins_Y[!is.na(bins_Y)]
    if (length(bins_Y) > 0) {
      Y_entrop_vals[i] <- entropy(table(bins_Y))
    }
    
    x_Z <- data_awake$Z[(pos - fenetre_rolling + 1):pos]
    bins_Z <- cut(x_Z, breaks = 10, labels = FALSE)
    bins_Z <- bins_Z[!is.na(bins_Z)]
    if (length(bins_Z) > 0) {
      Z_entrop_vals[i] <- entropy(table(bins_Z))
    }
    
    x_norme <- data_awake$norme[(pos - fenetre_rolling + 1):pos]
    bins_norme <- cut(x_norme, breaks = 10, labels = FALSE)
    bins_norme <- bins_norme[!is.na(bins_norme)]
    if (length(bins_norme) > 0) {
      norme_entrop_vals[i] <- entropy(table(bins_norme))
    }
  }
  
  desc_freq_glissants <- c(
    X_alpha_roll_mean = mean(X_alpha_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_alpha_roll_sd = sd(X_alpha_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_r2_roll_mean = mean(X_r2_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_r2_roll_sd = sd(X_r2_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_entropy_roll_mean = mean(X_entrop_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    X_entropy_roll_sd = sd(X_entrop_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Y_alpha_roll_mean = mean(Y_alpha_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_alpha_roll_sd = sd(Y_alpha_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_r2_roll_mean = mean(Y_r2_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_r2_roll_sd = sd(Y_r2_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_entropy_roll_mean = mean(Y_entrop_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Y_entropy_roll_sd = sd(Y_entrop_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    Z_alpha_roll_mean = mean(Z_alpha_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_alpha_roll_sd = sd(Z_alpha_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_r2_roll_mean = mean(Z_r2_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_r2_roll_sd = sd(Z_r2_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_entropy_roll_mean = mean(Z_entrop_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Z_entropy_roll_sd = sd(Z_entrop_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    norme_alpha_roll_mean = mean(norme_alpha_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_alpha_roll_sd = sd(norme_alpha_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_r2_roll_mean = mean(norme_r2_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_r2_roll_sd = sd(norme_r2_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_entropy_roll_mean = mean(norme_entrop_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    norme_entropy_roll_sd = sd(norme_entrop_vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  calcul_dfa_global <- function(signal) {
    signal_clean <- signal[!is.na(signal)]
    
    if (length(signal_clean) < 100) {
      return(c(alpha_global = NA, alpha_min = NA, alpha_max = NA, R2 = NA))
    }
    
    if (sd(signal_clean) == 0) {
      return(c(alpha_global = NA, alpha_min = NA, alpha_max = NA, R2 = NA))
    }
    
    result <- tryCatch({
      dfa_global <- dfa(signal_clean, 
                        window.size.range = c(10, floor(length(signal_clean)/3)), 
                        npoints = 20, do.plot = FALSE)
      
      alpha_global <- estimate(dfa_global)[[1]]
      sizes <- dfa_global$window.sizes
      fluct <- dfa_global$fluctuation.function
      
      if (any(!is.finite(fluct)) || any(!is.finite(sizes))) {
        return(c(alpha_global = NA, alpha_min = NA, alpha_max = NA, R2 = NA))
      }
      
      df <- data.frame(x = log(sizes), y = log(fluct))
      df <- df[is.finite(df$x) & is.finite(df$y), ]
      
      if (nrow(df) < 5) {
        return(c(alpha_global = NA, alpha_min = NA, alpha_max = NA, R2 = NA))
      }
      
      lm_mod <- lm(y ~ x, df)
      r2 <- summary(lm_mod)$r.squared
      conf <- confint(lm_mod, "x", level = 0.95)
      
      c(alpha_global = alpha_global,
        alpha_min = conf[1],
        alpha_max = conf[2],
        R2 = r2)
    }, error = function(e) {
      c(alpha_global = NA, alpha_min = NA, alpha_max = NA, R2 = NA)
    })
    
    return(result)
  }
  
  X_dfa_global <- calcul_dfa_global(data_awake$X)
  Y_dfa_global <- calcul_dfa_global(data_awake$Y)
  Z_dfa_global <- calcul_dfa_global(data_awake$Z)
  norme_dfa_global <- calcul_dfa_global(data_awake$norme)
  
  
  desc_dfa <- c(
    X_alpha_global = X_dfa_global["alpha_global"],
    X_alpha_min = X_dfa_global["alpha_min"],
    X_alpha_max = X_dfa_global["alpha_max"],
    X_R2 = X_dfa_global["R2"],
    
    Y_alpha_global = Y_dfa_global["alpha_global"],
    Y_alpha_min = Y_dfa_global["alpha_min"],
    Y_alpha_max = Y_dfa_global["alpha_max"],
    Y_R2 = Y_dfa_global["R2"],
    
    Z_alpha_global = Z_dfa_global["alpha_global"],
    Z_alpha_min = Z_dfa_global["alpha_min"],
    Z_alpha_max = Z_dfa_global["alpha_max"],
    Z_R2 = Z_dfa_global["R2"],
    
    norme_alpha_global = norme_dfa_global["alpha_global"],
    norme_alpha_min = norme_dfa_global["alpha_min"],
    norme_alpha_max = norme_dfa_global["alpha_max"],
    norme_R2 = norme_dfa_global["R2"]
  )
  
  descripteurs <- c(desc_global, desc_utilisation, desc_glissants, desc_freq_glissants, desc_dfa)
  
  ligne <- data.frame(patient = patient_id, t(descripteurs), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  return(ligne)
}
```

```{r extraction}
matrice_descripteurs <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(files)) {
  ligne <- extraire_descripteurs(files[i], n_echantillonnage = n_echantillonnage,
                                 step_dfa = step_dfa_glissante)
  matrice_descripteurs <- rbind(matrice_descripteurs, ligne)
}
```

```{r sauvegarde}
if (nrow(matrice_descripteurs) > 0) {
  # Nom fixe : c'est le fichier lu par 02_modelisation.R
  write.csv(matrice_descripteurs, chemin_sortie, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r apercu}
if (nrow(matrice_descripteurs) > 0) {
  head(matrice_descripteurs[, 1:min(10, ncol(matrice_descripteurs))])
}
```
